blockhelp-cut-hide: Hold to cut into hide pieces
itemdesc-hidepiece-raw: One leather-worth of raw hide. Seal in 2 L limewater for 20 hours or 2 L diluted borax for 18 hours. Spoils like a raw hide. Sneak + right-click to stack on the ground.
itemdesc-hidepiece-soaked: Scrape with a knife in the crafting grid. Sneak + right-click to stack on the ground.
itemdesc-hidepiece-scraped: Seal in 2 L weak tannin for 72 hours. Sneak + right-click to stack on the ground.
itemdesc-hidepiece-prepared: Seal in 2 L strong tannin for 108 hours to make one normal leather. Sneak + right-click to stack on the ground.
